# CRoaring dependency

Unmodified official release v5.3.2 amalgamation (`roaring.c`, `roaring.h`) and LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/RoaringBitmap/CRoaring/releases/tag/v5.3.2

See LOCK.json for exact local bytes, SHA-256 and official release digests.
This version is an engineering choice; the paper did not specify its Roaring version.
Only the C API is used through the project ownership adapter. The optional upstream
C++ header download timed out/failed; it is not a required build input and is not
replaced with another bitmap algorithm. Builds are offline after these files exist.

Upstream license is dual Apache-2.0/MIT; original license text is retained unchanged.
